reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Direct GSDMD N-terminal membrane action tested by purified protein/defined lipid reconstitution, orthogonal physical permeability and qualified mutant cellular rescue; conditional indirect-effector branch.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of original Methods, supplements or validated protein/membrane/cell protocols to select and verify transferable conditions. Naming unknown settings and proposing local validation does not meet this separate lookup requirement.

The four conditions omit protease-only and matched purification controls and an independent positive complete-release/reference control. The roles of these prospective comparisons are needed to attribute cleavage-associated leakage to GSDMD. One control deduction.

checks.quote: Cytokine release is a consequence of membrane compromise (lytic death)
checks.reason: The packet only states that processing and release are separable. It does not establish that all release requires terminal lysis. The positive conclusion likewise excludes all cellular effectors from evidence of cell-free sufficiency and fragment-expression killing.
No operational identity, cleavage-boundary, purity, aggregation or functional-integrity verification resolves this prerequisite.
Unknown lipid/buffer/temperature/protein/expression settings are deferred to generic optimization without concrete calibration-to-choice procedures.
No membrane-free reporter/protein interference test, measurement recovery/dynamic-range acceptance or calibration failure response. Missing positive control itself is charged under C, not here.
No fractional-release normalization, original-cell denominator, baseline/background or weak/saturated/missing measurement rules quantify the named dye and cytokine readouts.
No independent protein/lipid preparation/culture replication and justified precision/power or variance pilot.
No randomized/balanced processing, allocation concealment or blinded imaging/analysis or justified equivalent.
No prospective technical exclusions, attrition, all-field retention or stopping policy preserving biological failures.
No primary statistical contrast/model, uncertainty construction or multiplicity handling.
No bounded parameter/sensitivity series, technical evaluation criterion and lock.
Changing lipid composition or titrating expression is suggested, but no refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after revision.

checks.quote: Its ability to induce lytic death strictly depends on other cellular factors
checks.reason: Negative artificial reconstitution does not prove indirect execution; a valid protein preparation or appropriate membrane may be absent. Cellular killing does not identify a distinct executor.

checks.quote: Transfect the "tested cells" with an inducible expression vector
checks.reason: This repeats the packet's fragment-expression phenotype without a selective membrane-activity perturbation and qualified rescue. It cannot show that the physical activity observed in vitro drives the cell phenotype.
No linked sample/construct/preparation/raw-data manifest, analysis settings/versions and exclusion provenance.

The fundamental direct-versus-indirect question and minimal membrane plus structural readout are relevant. The design assumes reagent competence, lacks core controls and quantitative execution, and interprets a negative artificial assay as proof of an indirect mechanism. Its proposed discrepancy troubleshooting is specific enough to count under P11, but it is not fresh confirmation.
